mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDP (GDPC1) signals an expanding economy, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window or 20d returns not significantly higher than baseline (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 1.5% triggers short-term market stress, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns not significantly negative (p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS crosses above 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent quarterly growth in GDP (GDPC1) and falling unemployment (UNRATE) during an expansionary phase amplifies economic confidence, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 rises > 2% and UNRATE falls < 6.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: No significant positive 60d returns (p > 0.05) when both conditions met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) below 2.5% during late-cycle expansion reduces policy uncertainty, prompting positive S&P 500 returns within 20 days.
failure_condition: 20d returns not positive (p > 0.05) when CPIAUCSL drops below 2.5% in that regime.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in unemployment (UNRATE) above 6.5% in a high-unemployment period signals labor market stress, leading to negative S&P 500 returns within 20 days.
failure_condition: 20d returns not significantly negative (p > 0.05) when UNRATE spikes.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous quarterly growth in GDP (GDPC1) and industrial production (INDPRO) during an expansionary cycle boosts economic momentum, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 up 2% and INDPRO up 1% in 3 months
failure_condition: No significant positive returns (p > 0.05) when both rise as specified.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 1.0% during post-shock recovery erodes market optimism, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 20 days.
failure_condition: 20d returns not negative (p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS rises above 1.0% in that regime.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent monthly growth in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (RSAFS) above 5% in an expansionary demand surge strengthens economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
candidate_trigger: Both HOUST and RSAFS rise >5% in 3 months
failure_condition: No significant positive returns (p > 0.05) when both rise >5%.
